note: Adapted from the original English description of Krishna & Emerson 1962 (new species; type locality Ine Island, Arno Atoll, Marshall Islands); the original does not describe the worker. The measurements are translated verbatim from tables 2 and 3 of the original, in millimetres; n=10 alates, n=16 soldiers.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Compared with G. palauensis the alate has differently shaped compound eyes, ocelli that are not so oblique, narrower and shorter wings, and posterolateral margins of the pronotum that are not so broadly rounded; compared with the type series of G. xantholabrum from Samoa, the head, pronotum and wings are shorter and narrower, the posterolateral margins of the pronotum more broadly rounded and the posterior margin straight, and the compound eyes smaller and differently shaped. Compared with G. schmidti the soldier has a smaller head, a steeper frontal slope, shorter mandibles with a distinctly swollen outer base, and a weaker constriction of the postmentum; compared with G. palauensis the frontal slope is steeper, the middle of the posterior margin of the head is not concave, and the anterior margin of the pronotum is more deeply concave; compared with G. taveuniensis the head is longer and wider, the mandibles longer, the postmentum longer with a stronger constriction, and the posterolateral margins of the pronotum rounded.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark smoky brown, paler anteriorly; labrum yellowish brown; antennae pale smoky brown; pronotum concolorous with the anterior part of the head; femora pale smoky brown, tibiae whitish; tergites pale to dark brown; wing membrane pale smoky brown, the wing scales darker. Head with a small number of scattered erect setae; pronotal margin and disc with long and short setae. Y suture visible. Compound eyes small; ocelli small, oval, oblique, touching the compound eyes. Antennae 11—12-segmented, the second segment longer than the third or fourth, the third of variable length. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin concave; posterolateral margins broadly rounded; posterior margin straight. Media of the hind wing arising from the radial sector beyond the wing scale, about 1.20 mm from the suture. Measurements (mm; type and paratype series): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 0.99—1.13; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 0.83—0.90; head width 0.90—0.98; compound eye diameter 0.25—0.29; distance below the compound eye 0.11—0.14; ocellus length 0.09—0.11; pronotum median length 0.45—0.53, maximum length 0.56—0.60, width 0.83—0.88; hind tibia length 0.79—0.81; forewing length (from the suture) 4.95—5.37, width 1.39—1.50.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Middle of the head pale brown, the lateral and posterior areas yellowish brown, yellow behind the frontal slope, the frons pale brown; labrum pale yellow; mandibles brown, paler at the base; antennae and legs pale yellow; pronotum pale yellowish brown with brown margins; tergites pale yellow. Head with a small number of scattered erect setae; pronotal margin and disc with long and short setae. Sides of the head parallel; middle of the posterior margin concave; anterodorsal swelling indistinct; middle of the frons slightly concave; frontal slope about 40—45° in lateral view. Anterior margin of the labrum broadly rounded. Mandibles short, the outer edge slightly concave in the middle; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the first and second close together and forming an acute angle, the posterior edge of the second and the anterior edge of the third forming a concave cutting edge; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the first larger and the second very small (indistinct in some specimens), the tip of the first marginal tooth 0.30 mm from the apical tooth. Postmentum widest at the anterior third, narrowing posteriorly, the widest part nearly 2 times the narrowest. Antennae 10—11-segmented. Pronotum variable in shape and size; anterior margin angular and concave; anterolateral corners rounded; lateral margins rounded (straight in some specimens); posterolateral margins straight or concave; posterior margin slightly concave. Measurements (mm; holotype and paratype series): head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.12—1.58; head width 0.88—1.05; head height 0.75—0.90; left mandible length 0.68—0.75; maximum postmentum width 0.32—0.38, minimum width 0.15—0.19, length 0.69—1.13; pronotum median length 0.41—0.54, maximum length 0.53—0.69, width 0.75—1.14; hind tibia length 0.53—0.71.
